description: A single, floor-length curtain, likely made of a light to medium-weight fabric. It is presented in a neutral, pale grey or off-white color, suggesting versatility in interior design. The curtain is gathered at the top, creating a series of neat, vertical pleats that fall uniformly down to the hem. The pleats are well-defined, indicating a structured drape, and the hem appears to be slightly wavy or uneven, adding a touch of natural flow. The background is plain black, isolating the curtain and highlighting its form and texture. This type of curtain is typically used to cover windows or as a room divider.
